payload.artist_html: Larissa de Souza Ribeiro and Marco Aurélio Gallo de França
payload.description_html: Schematic of Parvodus anterior teeth (A, C, D) and an anterolateral tooth (B). The shapes elucidate some characteristics that occur in other species of Parvodus and that contrast with those of the new species described here. (A) Parvodus curvidens; (B) Parvodus lusitanicus; (C) Parvodus tikiensis; (D) Parvodus graciliani sp. nov., Holotype LAPEP-0532D. Scale bar: 1 mm. Adapted from Ansorge (1990); Bhat et al. (2018); Duffin and Thies (1997); Kriwet (2004); and Rees et al. (2013).
